summary: PicoShare is a lightweight, self-hosted web service designed for uploading and sharing individual files or images. It provides a straightforward interface that allows users to transfer assets quickly without complex configuration.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams needing a private, no-frills file drop utility running on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places copyleft requirements on your deployment if you modify and distribute the source code, and feature depth is intentionally minimal compared to full enterprise cloud storage.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires a persistent volume mounted for stored files and a standard reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
